_comment: Test positions. 'moves' is the column sequence from an empty board (X moves first). 'good' lists acceptable answers; null means no known correct answer.

positions.name: opening
positions.why: Empty board. Connect Four theory: the centre column is the only first move that wins with perfect play.

positions.name: win_in_1
positions.why: X has three on the bottom row (cols 0-2); column 3 wins immediately.

positions.name: must_block
positions.why: O to move; X threatens to complete cols 0-3 on the bottom row, so O must block column 3.

positions.name: trap
positions.why: X to move. O has three on row 1 (cols 1-3) with empty squares under (0,1) and (4,1); playing col 0 or col 4 lets O win next move.

positions.name: midgame
positions.why: O to move, no immediate wins or forced blocks. Used to measure consistency when there is no obvious answer.
